name.title: DP_GNC_SAC_PX
name.sysdesc: Data product to capture high rate (32Hz) Solar Array Commander (from GNC FSW) inputs to the solar array hardware (PX). This DP complements the hardware data product DP_GNC_SA_HW_HGH_RATE_PX.

field.sysdesc: Continuous rate profile. Data source is same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_PROFILE_RATE.
Profile status. Data source is same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_PROFILE_STATUS.
Current angle using step count. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_SA_POS.
Current desired angle. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_DESIRED_POS.
Angle not affected by stops, constraints, or deadband. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_IDEAL_POS.
Total cumulative steps. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_CUMULATIVE_STEPS.
Pot angle estimate. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_PRIME_POT_ANG.
Difference between prime pot and gnc. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_PRIME_POT_ERR.
Pot angle estimate. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_BACKUP_POT_ANG.
Lagged step count. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_LAG_STEP_COUNT.
Accumulated step error. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_ACCUM_STEP_ERR.
Sun optimal SA position. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_SUN_OPTIMAL_SA_POS.
Angle between SA normal and sun. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_SUN_INCIDENCE.
Continuous quantized angle profile. Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_SAC_PX_PROFILE_POS.
Bit-packed channel to track SAC status (includes GNC_SAC_PX_SUN_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATING tlm channel). Data source is the same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_32HZ_STATUS.
